questions.question: You receive an email saying your account will be deleted unless you click a link immediately. What should you do first?
options: Click the link quickly to save the account
Do not click; verify by contacting the service directly
Reply with your password to confirm identity
Forward it to all your friends

questions.question: Which of these is the strongest password?
What does 'phishing' refer to?
options: Tricking people into revealing sensitive info via fake messages

questions.question: What extra security does Two-Factor Authentication (2FA) add?
options: A second, separate verification step besides your password

questions.question: You find a USB drive in the parking lot. What is the safe action?
options: Plug it into your work laptop to find the owner
Do not plug it in; hand it to IT/security
Plug it into a public PC
